annotations.title: Fill history for a balance manager

description: Fills (OrderFilled) where a given DeepBook BalanceManager was the maker or the taker in one pool, newest first: time, its side, price, qty, fee, tx. Public data; no keys. Education/information only; not financial advice. Read-only public data, may be delayed or wrong. Free: 100 calls/day per client, then 0.002 USDC per call on Sui mainnet, prepaid in batches of about 0.01 USDC (the payment-required response gives an exact amount and a payment_token).

payment_token.description: Only after the free tier: the private payment_token from the payment-required response; it holds your prepaid calls

payment_tx.description: Only after the free tier: Sui transaction digest of your exact USDC payment for payment_token (see the payment-required response)

pool.description: DeepBook pool name BASE_QUOTE, e.g. SUI_USDC (case-insensitive; '/' or '-' also accepted)

name: get_bm_fills
